description_en: Queries the binding details of an upstream identity provider for a specified instance and identity provider type, including the logon callback URL and metadata
description_zh: 用于查询指定实例与身份提供商类型的上游身份提供商绑定详情，包含登录回调地址与元数据等信息
kebab_example: aliyun agentteams get-identity-provider --instance-id agentteams-xxx --identity-provider-type DingTalk --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: The identity provider type. Currently, only DingTalk is supported
parameters.help_zh: 身份提供商类型，目前仅支持钉钉
parameters.name: identity_provider_type
